audit_source:
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254ProofCompiler
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254ProofCompilerAudit
open Code254 Code254Proof Enum254 Code254ProofCompiler

theorem truth_word : compile RawProof.truth = discard := rfl

theorem truth_contract : Contract (compile RawProof.truth) 0 :=
  compile_contract .truth rfl

theorem axiom8_contract (a b c u : Nat) :
    Contract (compile (.r8 a b c u)) (rho8 a b c u) :=
  compile_contract (.r8 a b c u) rfl

theorem gen_contract_caller (a : Nat) (p : RawProof) (hp : p.valid = true) :
    Contract (compile (.gen a p)) (wal a p.conclusion) :=
  compile_contract (.gen a p) hp

theorem mp_contract_caller (b : Nat) (p q : RawProof)
    (hp : p.valid = true) (hq : q.valid = true)
    (he : q.conclusion = wim p.conclusion b) :
    Contract (compile (.mp b p q)) b :=
  compile_contract (.mp b p q) (by simp [RawProof.valid, hp, hq, he])

theorem explicit_word_refutes_from_every_state (p : RawProof)
    (hp : p.valid = true) (hf : p.conclusion = F) :
    ∀ w, cexec (refutationWord p) w = none :=
  refutation_cexec_none p hp hf

theorem data_refutation_halts (p : RawProof) (hp : p.valid = true)
    (hf : p.conclusion = F) : Enum254.Halts := refutation_halts p hp hf

#print axioms truth_word
#print axioms truth_contract
#print axioms axiom8_contract
#print axioms gen_contract_caller
#print axioms mp_contract_caller
#print axioms explicit_word_refutes_from_every_state
#print axioms data_refutation_halts
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254ProofCompilerAudit
